items.title: An automated dual-mode platform for affinity-based screening of natural products using a pressure-driven strategy
items.description: BACKGROUND: Affinity-based screening is a powerful strategy for drug screening from natural products. However, conventional workflows - whether based on ultrafiltration (UF) or magnetic beads - often involve labour-intensive manual operations, which can limit throughput. Herein, a pressure-driven automated platform for affinity-based screening is reported, compatible with both UF-based and silica bead (SB)-based modes.
